name: Sordesdaemon
savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Miasma of Pollution
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn in it must succeed at a DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Sickened 2 (plus Slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). Creatures in the aura can't reduce the value of the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute. Creatures made of water (such as water elementals) and plant creatures use an outcome one degree of success worse than the result of their save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pollution Infusion
offensiveAbilities.description:
Non-fiend creatures adjacent to the afflicted creature take a -1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against disease

Saving Throw DC 36 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 Drained 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Doomed 1 and Drained 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 Doomed 1 and Drained 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 Doomed 2 and Drained 2 (1 week)

Stage 5 dead.

Effect: Pollution Infusion

offensiveAbilities.name: Retch of Foulness
offensiveAbilities.description:
The sordesdaemon exhales a spray of sewage that deals 8d6 Acid Damage|options:area-damage]{8d6 acid damage and 8d6 poison damage} in a 30ft Cone (Basic DC 36 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

It can't use Retch of Foulness again for 1d4 rounds.

lv4spells.name: Translocate (At Will)
lv4spells.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

lv5spells.name: Translocate
lv5spells.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

lv5spells.name: Toxic Cloud (At Will)
lv5spells.description:
You conjure a poisonous fog. This functions as Mist, except the area moves 10 feet away from you each round. You deal 6d8 poison damage to each breathing creature that starts its turn in the spell's area. You can Dismiss the spell.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

lv8spells.name: Desiccate
lv8spells.description:
You pull the moisture from the targets' bodies, dealing 10d10 void damage. Creatures made of water (such as water elementals) and plant creatures use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of their saving throw. Creatures whose bodies contain no significant moisture (such as earth elementals) are immune to desiccate.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

lv8spells.name: Spiritual Epidemic
lv8spells.description:
You curse the target, sapping its spirit and leaving a contagious trap in its essence. The target must attempt a Will save. Any creature that casts a divine or occult spell on the target while it's affected is targeted by spiritual epidemic and must also attempt a Will save. The curse continues to spread in this way.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Enfeebled 2 and Stupefied 2 for 1 round.

Failure The target is enfeebled 2 and stupefied 2 for 1 minute and Enfeebled 1 and Stupefied 1 permanently.

Critical Failure The target is Enfeebled 3 and Stupefied 3 for 1 minute and enfeebled 2 and stupefied 2 permanently.
